note: Availability is ALSO pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY in extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py); editing this file alone cannot loosen it. No source wordmark/logo is ever must-reuse-exact in generated mode.

brand.wordmark.description: Source wordmark SVG (full logo) used in let's talk / contact backgrounds.
brand.wordmark.licensing: Real, live freelance portfolio. Never reproduce in generated output; reference mode may cite it only as evidence of the source.

brand.monogram.description: Source small 'J' logo SVG in the about band.
brand.monogram.licensing: Real, live freelance portfolio. Never reproduce in generated output; reference mode may cite it only as evidence of the source.

brand.project-mark.description: Source logo variant used on work pages.
brand.project-mark.licensing: Real, live freelance portfolio. Never reproduce in generated output; reference mode may cite it only as evidence of the source.

brand.signature-trace.description: Handwritten 'J' and signature stroke data (script#trace-j / #trace-signature JSON) that drives every drawing animation. It is the owner's handwriting.
brand.signature-trace.licensing: Real, live freelance portfolio. Never reproduce in generated output; reference mode may cite it only as evidence of the source.

work.card-media.description: Client work thumbnails on work cards (lazy webp, 1200 wide).
work.card-media.licensing: Client/commissioned imagery; copyright of the owner and clients.

work.hero-media.description: Large project hero image (data-hero) used by the shared-element transition and the work page hero.

work.gallery-media.description: Stills, rows, pairs, triangles, large images, carousels, cards, app screens and device mockups inside case studies.

work.video.description: Self-hosted case-study videos (mp4, preload none) and their posters.

partner.logo.description: Logos of real partner studios and freelancers (220x220 webp).

social.share-image.description: OG share image of the source home page.
social.share-image.licensing: Real, live freelance portfolio. Never reproduce in generated output; reference mode may cite it only as evidence of the source.

font.display-face.description: Neue Haas Grotesk Display 400/700 woff2 files (commercial typeface).
font.display-face.licensing: Commercial font licence held by the source; a generated page needs its own licence or uses the fallback stack.

icon.ui.description: Generic UI glyphs drawn inline: slider chevrons, close-circle X, back arrow, menu bars.

generated.brand-mark.description: A brand mark generated for, or supplied by, the new page's owner (replaces wordmark, monogram and signature trace).

placeholder.brand-mark.description: Neutral placeholder mark (e.g. initials in the display face) until the owner supplies one.

generated.project-visual.description: AI-generated or user-supplied project imagery for fictional or the user's own work.

placeholder.project-video.description: User-supplied video or a neutral poster frame.

placeholder.partner-mark.description: Fictional collaborator monogram; never a real studio logo.

fictional.person-avatar.description: Avatar of a fictional person; never a real person's likeness.

placeholder.award-label.description: Placeholder recognition text/badge (marked placeholder); never a real award body, ranking or rating.

placeholder.url.description: Links on reserved domains only (.example, .invalid, example.com/.org/.net) or in-page anchors.

original.copy.description: Copy written for the new page; must not reuse source sentences (validator COPY rule).

licensed-or-fallback.font.description: The fallback stack "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif, or a display face the user licenses.
